title: The Unquiet: First Rites

texts.details:
You can close a wound. A healer's hands are not what makes a priestess of the Moon.

There is a spirit among the trees north-west of the village. It was one of ours, and it does not know that it has died. It walks where it used to walk and is angered that none answer. It should not have been left so.

We are taught that the Goddess takes the valiant among the dead and sets them riding across the sky as stars. This one has not been taken. Go and give it rest, $N. It will resist you. They believe we have come to take the last thing they have.
texts.objectives: Lay the Restless Shade to rest, among the trees north-west of Dolanaar, then return to your teacher.
texts.progress: Be as gentle as it allows.
texts.completion:
It is at peace? Then you have done the oldest thing the Sisterhood does. Older than our temple.

Elune is a goddess of peace, and peace is not only for the living. Most of the dead go where they should. A few cannot, because of how they died, or what they left undone. Those are ours to tend.

The younger races have had three wars and a plague in a single lifetime, and their lands are thick with the unquiet. Each is a piece of history that no one stayed to mourn. I would have you attend them, $N. Choose one of these. When you have twenty seasons, cross the sea to the humans' Cathedral in Stormwind, and seek High Priestess Laurena. She keeps the same watch by another name.

idea: The Unquiet, level 10 (Alliance): lay one restless shade near home, in the voice of the priest's own faith. Invented: the shade.
